# Dynamic Loading Overview




## What You Will Learn {#dynamic_loading_intro}


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>Parse command-line arguments to locate the shared library</li>
<li>Dynamically load <span class="doxyComputerOutput">qar-streaming-c</span> at runtime</li>
<li>Initialize and tear down the global library state</li>
</ul>

## Prerequisites {#dynamic_loading_prereq}


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>Build the SDK and locate the produced <span class="doxyComputerOutput">qar-streaming-c</span> shared library</li>
<li>Ensure runtime binaries sit next to the library (default assumption)</li>
</ul>

## Build and Run {#dynamic_loading_build}


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">cmake --build --preset x64-windows-debug --target dynamic_loading</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">./build/x64-windows/Debug/dynamic_loading.exe &lt;path-to-qar-streaming-c.dll&gt; [runtime-dir]</span></span></div>

</div>

## Load the Shared Library {#dynamic_loading_load}


<p>Use <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-dynamic-loading/#ga2f183f2df1f2f9db71fe520d154b1606">qar_library_load</a> to dynamically load the DLL/SO/Dylib.</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    printf(</span><span class="doxyHighlightStringLiteral">"Loading qar-streaming-c from: %s\n"</span><span class="doxyHighlight">, library_path);</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    {</span></span></div>
